studies.finding: AI used S0 throughout; S2 NOT_TESTED_NOT_REQUESTED, not solver UNKNOWN. Original observed-intensity wording did not clearly state latent denoising goal; this is a possible framing confound, not a causal attribution.
Nonblind fixed S2 exploratory totalmean errors improved on 6 points and worsened on 2; 2 whole comparisons UNKNOWN despite query-local CPE. No blind validation or route-gain inference.

New explicit latent expected-totalmean task: S0 lowest MAE/RMSE; AI requested S2 on 2/4, fixed S2 qualified 4/4 but both had worse aggregate errors than S0. Preserve negative result; not a paired prompt ablation.
